name: The Gritti Palace
positioning: The Gritti Palace, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Venice: a 15th-century Gothic palazzo on the Grand Canal, once the residence of Doge Andrea Gritti, filled with antiques, Rubelli fabrics and Murano chandeliers
best_for: Travelers who want a historic palazzo on the Grand Canal near Piazza San Marco and La Fenice
Couples looking for heritage suites, lagoon excursions by Riva yacht and a Sisley Paris spa

facts.text: The hotel is set on the Grand Canal in central Venice, near La Fenice Theatre and Piazza San Marco.
The hotel faces across the Grand Canal to the Salute church.
The palazzo dates to 1475, when the Pisani family gave it its current Gothic shape.
Rubelli fabrics cover walls and furniture, with Murano chandeliers.
Rooms feature rare antique furnishings, precious fabrics and Murano glass appliques and chandeliers.
Rooms have Signature Luxury Collection beds, marble bathrooms and Acqua di Parma amenities.
The Royal Suite holds reminders of former guest Somerset Maugham.
The Gritti SPA is branded by Sisley Paris and offers Phyto-Aromatic treatments.
The spa has single and double spa suites and a hammam.
Club del Doge Restaurant sits in a corner position on the Grand Canal and pays tribute to Venetian cuisine.
The Gritti Epicurean School is an open kitchen that has hosted wine tastings, culinary workshops and celebrations since 1975.
The Concierge desk is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

highlights.text: The Redentore Terrazza Suite is a two-storey suite with a 250-square-metre rooftop terrace overlooking Venice and the Grand Canal.
In 1525 the building became the private residence of the Doge of Venice, Andrea Gritti.
John Ruskin wrote 'The Stones of Venice' during a long stay at Palazzo Gritti with his wife Effie.
Riva Yacht Experiences take guests on tailored excursions of the northern and southern lagoons.
The Coppa Volpi Heritage Suite honours the Venice International Film Festival, and the Fenice Heritage Suite evokes the opera house.

considerations.text: The busy tourist route from the Accademia to Piazza San Marco is just around the corner.
High tide (acqua alta) occurs more often in autumn and winter, when sea water partly covers some areas of the city.
Rooms do not permit rollaway beds.
